refShapes.cell: a bare A1 reference on the form's own sheet; the Taxi package is one workbook, so no file prefix is needed
refShapes.derived: a resolver the render owns, set only where cell is null: a name in DiyaGlTaxiForms.DERIVED_NAMES, "pl:B<n>" for one Profit & Loss Acc cell, or "sum:B<n>,B<m>" for a total of several

notes.sheetNumbering: SE Short prints its own box numbers, one behind the 2026 form's from turnover on. Every box here carries the 2026 number.
notes.expenseBoxes: Boxes 11 to 20 read the Profit & Loss Account, not SE Short's own expense block: those sheet cells carry no CELL_MAP row, so R has no key for them, and the sheet blanks the block below £30,000 turnover while the form's permission is £90,000.
notes.emptyBoxes: Boxes 32, 35 and 38 print empty although the sheet computes O106 and holds D123 and O123: CELL_MAP names none of the three and the calculator emits none, so R carries no key either way.

sa103s.microcopy: Check these against your return. Box numbers match the 2026 form; nothing here is the HMRC document.
